title: Beyond the Happy Path: Generalizing Robot World Models from Simulated Failures
abstract: arXiv:2611.33925v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot world models are increasingly used to evaluate and plan policies, yet robot training data are dominated by successful demonstrations. Off the happy path, when a grasp is misaligned or mistimed and the object is pushed, tilted, or slips, their predictions break down. Across five pretrained action-conditioned models, object-motion error is at most 10.4% lower than that of a static baseline that copies the first frame, and two models are worse than this baseline. We present WorldReforge, which teaches world models what happens when manipulation goes wrong. We construct the Reforge dataset of 62k simulated trajectories by perturbing reference grasps in position, orientation, and closure timing, recording each resulting push, slip, or failed pickup with ground-truth object pose, contact, and surface points. WorldReforge turns this ground truth into two training signals without additional inference cost. Interaction Alignment focuses r

translated_title: 超越理想路径：从模拟失败中泛化机器人世界模型
translated_abstract: 机器人世界模型正越来越多地被用于评估和规划策略，然而机器人的训练数据主要由成功演示所主导。在理想路径之外——当抓取位置错位或时机不当，物体被推动、倾斜或滑落时——这些模型的预测就会失效。在五个预训练的动作条件化模型中，物体运动误差相比复制第一帧的静态基线最多仅低10.4%，其中两个模型的表现甚至不如该基线。我们提出了WorldReforge，它教会世界模型当操作出错时会发生什么。我们通过在位置、朝向和闭合时机上扰动参考抓取，构建了包含62k条模拟轨迹的Reforge数据集，记录由此产生的每一次推动、滑落或抓取失败，并附带物体位姿、接触和表面点的真值数据。WorldReforge将这些真值转化为两种训练信号，且不增加额外的推理成本。交互对齐聚焦于……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出WorldReforge方法，通过构建包含6.2万条模拟失败操作轨迹的Reforge数据集，教会机器人世界模型预测抓取错位、物体滑动等操作失败情形，突破现有模型仅依赖成功演示数据的局限。
en_tdlr: WorldReforge teaches robot world models to generalize beyond successful demonstrations by training on a 62k-trajectory dataset of simulated failed manipulations with ground-truth object pose, contact, and surface signals.
